display_long_description:
Our app may display streaming videos, which require a good internet connection and may not be available at all times.

DO XR is an immersive art viewer for Meta Quest that transforms how you experience digital and contemporary art.

Unlike traditional virtual galleries, DO XR is built around presence, quality, and scale. As you move closer to an artwork, you reveal its details — just like in a real exhibition.

Experience art beyond the screen

Enter curated VR spaces or bring artworks into your real environment using XR. Place pieces on your walls, walk around them, and explore them in full scale.

All artworks are XR-ready, uploaded by artists and galleries for intentional spatial presentation.

Discover and access art instantly

Scan QR codes from artists websites to open their artworks in XR. Build your own space and create a personal exhibition anywhere.

View solo or together

Explore art alone or with others:
	•	Join public VR rooms
	•	Create private rooms and invite friends
	•	Talk and explore with built-in voice chat

Designed for a real art experience
	•	High-resolution images and video
	•	True sense of scale and proximity
	•	Curated environments, not chaotic feeds

DO XR is a new way to experience digital art — with presence, context, and space.
